items.title: Thế giới hôm nay: 10/11/2026
items.summary: Thị trường đặc biệt bồn chồn về AI kể từ cuộc bầu cử giữa nhiệm kỳ của Mỹ hồi tuần trước; nhiều thành viên Đảng Dn chủ giành chiến thắng đã tỏ ra gay gắt với việc xy dựng các trung tm dữ liệu. Các nhà đầu tư cũng lo lắng về khối nợ ngày càng tăng của Softbank: công ty đã phát hành 40 tỷ USD dưới dạng các khoản vay và trái phiếu trong 12 tháng tính đến tháng 6. Giá cổ phiếu của họ đã giảm hơn một nửa kể từ mức đỉnh vào tháng đó. Tất cả những điều này gy áp lực buộc Son phải mang đến những tin [...] Kết quả hàng quý của Softbank sẽ thử thách niềm tin của các nhà đầu tư vào sự bùng nổ của trí tuệ nhn tạo. Masayoshi Son – nhà sáng lập kiêm giám đốc điều hành tập đoàn công nghệ Nhật Bản – đã đánh cược tương lai của công ty vào AI. Softbank đã đầu tư 65 tỷ USD vào OpenAI, dẫn đầu các dự án cơ sở hạ tầng như Stargate, và còn ra mắt SB Energy, một nhà cung cấp trung tm dữ liệu. Thái độ hoài nghi ngày càng tăng của thị trường đối với AI đã buộc SB Energy phải trì hoãn đợt phát hành cổ phiếu lần [...] hành cổ phiếu lần đầu ra công chúng vào tháng 9. OpenAI cũng đã hoãn việc niêm yết của mình.

results.input: Giải giúp mình bài toán tích phân: nguyên hàm của x^2 là gì?

result.actual_text:
Nguyên hàm của hàm số $f(x) = x^2$ được tính theo công thức tính nguyên hàm của hàm lũy thừa:

$$\int x^2 \, dx = \frac{x^{2+1}}{2+1} + C = \frac{x^3}{3} + C$$

Trong đó $C$ là hằng số thực bất kỳ.

items.title: All the latest updates on AI data centers | The Verge
items.summary:
Read Article >
 “We are a data center first company,” AMD CEO Lisa Su says.
 ## OpenAI is stepping back from NDAs for data center projects

  Following this week’s midterms where voters resoundingly voiced their opposition to data center expansion, OpenAI today announced new commitments to communities where it is working on data center projects, including that it won’t use non-disclosure agreements (NDAs) with public officials. [...] In an announcement on Monday, OpenAI says it will pilot its “Grid Protectors Program” at an upcoming data center in Effingham County, Georgia, where the company promises to free up to 1,000 megawatts of power during extreme weather or emergencies, enough to power air conditioners in around 700,000 homes.

  The announcement comes as opposition to data centers spreads across the US, in response to massive projects that have begun development and construction, frequently with little or no input from local residents. In Utah, residents protested after Box Elder County commissioners signed off on a data center expected to consume more than double the state’s peak electricity demand in 2025, and spread hot air in the desert valley surrounding the data center. [...] NBC News projects Democrat Sherrod Brown will win back his former Senate seat from Republican Jon Husted, who Brown had labeled “the face of data centers.” The National Republican Senatorial Committee warned in a leaked August memo that if Husted loses “and data centers get the blame, politicians across the country will take notice — and they will not go near the next one.”
 Data center-dense Texas turns blue.

  Both Democrats James Talarico and Gina Hinojosa are projected by NBC News to win their Senate and gubernatorial races, respectively. Hinojosa has called for a moratorium on data center development in the state, while Talarico has favored ending tax incentives and creating an “AI dividend” for Americans to share in profits.

  ## Voters in Texas agree: They hate data centers

items.title: Adobe Max 2026 Live Updates: All the AI, Photo and Video News - CNET
items.summary:
The biggest changes are the general release of AI assistants in Photoshop, Adobe Express and its AI hub, Firefly, first teased at last year’s conference. These assistants are similar to chatbots, where you enter your request and the AI does the editing for you. Adobe also released AI music generation tools and new photo editing modes. For video editors, too, there are the new Premiere mobile apps.

Adobe tech is also now showing up in ChatGPT and Claude; Disney is using Firefly to help design theme park rides. And from what CNET has heard from Adobe execs, the company isn’t planning to slow down its AI research any time soon. [...] Adobe’s flagship programs, like Photoshop, have undergone major AI makeovers, including recent developments like AI audio and soundtrack generation. This has been to the dismay of some of its creative customers who are wary of generative AI. This year is expected to be no different. But there are other tensions brewing, including Adobe’s $75 million settlement with the US Justice Department over subscription cancellations and new vibe-coded and free Adobe alternatives.

CNET is on the ground in Miami Beach, Florida, to bring you all the latest news. Check back here for updates.

Artificial intelligence is changing the workplace. Learn how it could affect jobs and where to find AI training in Alabama.

By Lenise Ligon

Add Us On GoogleAdd as a preferred source on Google

MOBILE, Ala. (WALA) - Artificial intelligence is becoming a bigger part of everyday life, raising questions about what the technology could mean for workers and their jobs.

Some economists believe AI poses a particular threat to entry-level and repetitive work, including call center, data entry and junior copywriting jobs, according to The Wall Street Journal. Those tasks may be easier to automate. [...] Job growth in some office fields, including accounting, law and finance, has been slow, while tech and media jobs have declined since 2022. Microsoft also offered buyouts to tens of thousands of employees. Those trends do not necessarily mean AI caused the changes.

But AI could also create opportunities. AI Summary Cowin Robotics said on Nov. 10 it won a new order for a robot integration system from a global energy storage system (ESS) company. The system will be deployed at the customer’s mid- to large-sized ESS manufacturing line. The company did not disclose the counterparty or contract value for business reasons. Cowin Robotics said ESS-related robot orders have continued this year and it is discussing supplying robot systems to other gigafactories the customer is expanding [...] Cowin Robotics said it has continued to win ESS robot orders this year.
